summary: Iter 22 — Full verification of the 4 RemedialFlow UX improvements on viewport 390x844 web preview. All backend assertions (6 tests, 1 skipped before fix then re-passed) and all 4 frontend feature flows pass. (1) PHOTOS: Installer uploaded 12 photos to one open NC via POST /api/ncs/{nc_id}/evidence (meta kind=photo source=gallery, unique client_id each). All 12 appear as drafts in GET /api/projects/{pid} ncs[].photos (len>=12 verified). ZIP export (GET /api/export/link?project_id=) returns PDFs; pymupdf page.get_images() shows image count per PDF stays within server cap and submission works end-to-end. (2) EARNINGS: /api/earnings items now include 'ncs' array for the installer; totals match sums (earned=sum(items status=earned), paid=sum(items status=paid), in_progress=sum(pending.amount)). UI shows earnings-summary with three cards displaying earnings-potential=£37,735.00, earnings-unpaid=£1,250.00, earnings-paid=£57,150.00; tabs potential/pending/paid render 150/6/160 rows resp.; row testIDs earning-row-<tab>-<REF> contain address, ref + NC numbers, amount and the correct badge (Estimated / Payment pending / Paid). Tapping cards and tabs both switch list correctly. (3) JOBS: jobs-summary renders all 5 cards: action(1) this_week(1) next_week(0) unscheduled(7) completed(11). Each project appears once; job-ncs-<REF> text matches pattern 'N NC(s) assigned (NC-01, ...) · X/Y done' and open-job-<REF> is present. Tapping jobs-card-this_week filters list to only jobs-section-this_week and surfaces jobs-filter-clear; tapping the same card again restores filter=all (verified via DOM re-check). (4) THEME: theme-setting with theme-light/theme-dark/theme-auto visible on installer Profile tab (component also used on staff Account). Selecting Dark re-renders Account, Jobs, Earnings and Projects screens with #0A0A0A surfaces and light text (screens 04-06). No dark-on-dark contrast suspects were detected by a DOM colour diff pass across visible leaf elements. Reloading the page and logging back in both preserve the Dark preference (persisted via AsyncStorage/localStorage). Switching back to Light restores. Quick regression confirmed: login works for admin/employee/installer, GET /api/projects returns items for the employee, staff dashboard/projects pages load, and TEST-P11APR-1792502160 shows the previously-approved NC with status 'Internally Completed'.
action_items: No code changes required for iter-22 scope. All 4 UX acceptance areas verified end-to-end on the web preview at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/(installer)/earnings.tsx: three summary tiles always rendered when d exists; items filtered by status; potential rows read d.pending (ncs + ncs_done), earned/paid rows read d.items with e.ncs ?? []; keys use e.id / p.project_id so React can diff; money() formatting + numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit avoid overflow of large totals in the small tiles.

frontend/app/(installer)/jobs.tsx sectionOf: deterministic single-section placement from installer's own NC statuses and schedule only; weekBounds uses local date math; filter toggle via setFilter(on ? 'all' : key); job-card-<REF>, job-ncs-<REF>, open-job-<REF> all present; summary cards use jobs-card-<key> and accessibilityState.selected which drives aria-selected.

frontend/src/theme.ts: setThemePref writes AsyncStorage (localStorage on web) and notifies listeners; useSyncExternalStore makes useTheme reactive; auto resolves via useColorScheme(); dark palette inverts surface + text, keeps brand colours and status colours identical — all `on*` tokens remain legible against their paired surfaces.

frontend/src/components/ProfileView.tsx: theme-setting segmented control renders Feather sun/moon/smartphone icons with onBrandSecondary applied when selected; hint 'Auto follows your device setting.' present; shown on both installer Profile and staff Account via shared component.

frontend/src/components/NCCard.tsx: pickGallery uses selectionLimit:0 (unlimited) with preferredAssetRepresentationMode=Current + videoExportPreset=Passthrough; drafts render in a horizontal FlatList (draft-thumb-<fid>) with windowSize=5 so 12+ photos scroll smoothly; captured_at pulled only from EXIF for gallery sources.
backend /api/earnings: items contain 'ncs' per installer (confirmed via test_earnings_items_include_ncs); totals equal sum of items/pending (confirmed via test_earnings_totals_match).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 12 draft photos to one open NC on an existing installer project via POST /api/ncs/{nc_id}/evidence to satisfy the 12-photo rendering assertion. Theme preference briefly changed to Dark during tests and restored to Light at the end for Ian Installer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints exercised: GET /api/earnings (installer, now returns 'ncs' per item + 'pending' with ncs/ncs_done), POST /api/ncs/{nc_id}/evidence (multipart with meta JSON including client_id), GET /api/projects/{pid} (ncs[].photos surfaces drafts), GET /api/export/link?project_id= (returns a URL to a ZIP of PDFs). Login quick-buttons on /login auto-fill demo credentials. Dark-theme sanity checked using a DOM colour-diff pass; the body itself has transparent bg in react-native-web — the dark surface is painted on the top-level View, so always sample a child View or screenshot rather than document.body for background colour validation.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all acceptance criteria met on the first UI pass.
